needsBespoke.why: Ornn's kit is expressible as a combination of existing primitives (target-debuff placing Brittle + conditional-damage consuming it, dot for W, recast-or-multipart for R, charge-or-channel for the action-locking windows), but the Brittle chain crosses three abilities (W/R apply it, E/R's own CC consumes it) and needs to be modeled as shared debuff state rather than a single self-contained ability effect.

unsettled.question: When Searing Charge (E) or Call of the Forge God (R) applies its knockup+stun to a target that is simultaneously being freshly given Brittle by that same hit, does it consume that just-applied Brittle for the passive's bonus magic damage, or does consumption only happen against Brittle that was already present from an earlier, separate hit?
options: Self-consumption: any stun/knockup from E or R that also applies Brittle immediately consumes it for bonus damage on the same hit
No self-consumption: Brittle must already exist on the target (e.g. from a prior W or R hit) before a later immobilize/silence can consume it
quotes: '''Ornn's''' and allies' {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects or {{tip|silence|silences}} against ''Brittle'' enemies will consume the debuff to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}
''{{cai|Searing Charge|Ornn}}'' and ''{{ai|Call of the Forge God|Ornn}}'' each apply both airborne and stun simultaneously for the same duration for this reason.

Assume Ornn always reaches max dash range and a wall/terrain boundary triggers the shockwave, dealing both damage instances each cast

Against a single stationary dummy, should the sim assume this recast always successfully connects for the full 'Total Magic Damage' (both passes), or could/should it sometimes only be modeled as the single first-pass hit?
options: Always assume the recast connects, dealing both passes' damage each R cast
Model uncertainty/geometry and only count the guaranteed first pass unless a hit is otherwise assumed
quotes: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain. If he collides with the elemental, he sends it stampeding in the same direction.

proposal: Open with Q (Volcanic Rupture) on the dummy for immediate physical damage.
Cast W (Bellows Breath) through the dummy so all 5 ticks land and the final tick applies Brittle.

Immediately follow with E (Searing Charge) dashing through the dummy so its stun lands while the target is Brittle, aiming to consume Brittle for the passive's bonus magic damage in addition to E's own charge/shockwave damage.
Cast R (Call of the Forge God) to send the elemental through the dummy for the first damage pass, slow, and a fresh Brittle application.
As soon as the ~1.25s window allows, recast R to dash into the elemental and send it back through the dummy for the second damage pass and its own stun.
Weave basic attacks on cooldown throughout; against a Brittle dummy these on-hit attacks knock it back rather than dealing bonus damage.
Repeat Q, W, E, R(+recast) in whatever order each ability comes off cooldown for the remainder of the 15s window, prioritizing keeping Brittle up so E's/R's stun can consume it.

Is it worth spending early casts on Q (no Brittle synergy) versus prioritizing getting W and R's Brittle up before E fires, given cooldown lengths (Q 9-7s, W 12-10s, E 14-12s, R 140-100s)?
